title: Fishing Koushien
overview:
Experience four kinds of fishing realistically!

Fishing Koushien is a fishing competition played over four rounds, each in a different place with a different style of fishing. Face off against rival anglers, watching depth, line and drag as you work each fish to the surface and try to out-fish the competition.

- Round 1: a timed black bass tournament from a boat on Lake Kawaguchi
- Round 2: boat fishing for grunt (isaki) off Tsurugisaki
- Round 3: a head-to-head herabuna crucian carp contest
- Round 4: big-game fishing off Saipan

4種類の釣りがリアルに体験できる！
